audience: small and mid-sized businesses that keep clients, invoices and stock in PHC GO

useCases.title: Review the client list before a call
useCases.text: Read the clients in your PHC GO account, up to 100 records per call. Use the list to check client details before you call or reply.

useCases.title: Review recent invoices in PHC GO
useCases.text: Read the invoices in your PHC GO account, up to 100 records per call. Ask the assistant to summarize them for a monthly review.

useCases.title: Check stock before you promise delivery
useCases.text: Read the stock records in your PHC GO account, up to 100 records per call. Check the stock before you confirm a delivery date to a client.

useCases.title: Combine clients, invoices and stock in one report
useCases.text: Read the client, invoice and stock lists in one session. Ask the assistant to combine them into a short report for your team.
